title: The GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 - a Public Tool to Assess Generative AI Tools for the Design of Interactive Digital Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to generate historical narratives set in both the Global North and Global South, and evaluating the outputs for colonial perspectives, Western structural defaults, and cultural misrepresentation using an automated LLM bias rater validated by human raters with lived experience.

Generating historical narratives focused on specific genders (e.g., women in 1980s Sweden/Germany) and evaluating the text for patriarchal perspectives, male-centric framing, and gender stereotypes (e.g., 'yuppie' tropes) using an automated bias rater scoring fairness, representation, and sensitivity.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Generating narratives specifically centered on LGBTQ+ individuals (e.g., a homosexual man in 1990s Thailand, a non-binary person in 2010s Sweden) and evaluating the outputs for historical erasure, mislabeling, and stereotyping using an automated bias detection rubric.

Using a customized LLM bias rater prompt that explicitly checks for overlapping oppressive perspectives (e.g., the erasure of immigrant women) to evaluate generated narratives on fairness, representation, and sensitivity.
